summary: Python library for building and sharing web demos of machine learning models or any Python function in a few lines.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Gradio is an open-source Python package for quickly building a demo or web app for a machine learning model, an API or any Python function, and sharing it with a link. No JavaScript, CSS or web hosting experience is needed.
sixtySeconds.problem: Showing a model to others usually means building a web front end. Gradio wraps your function in a browser UI with a few lines of Python.
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for the fastest way to put a UI around a Python function, with 30+ built-in components, hot reload and easy sharing.

overview: Install with pip, ideally in a virtual environment. Gradio runs in your editor, Jupyter, Google Colab or anywhere you write Python.
The Interface class takes a function, input components and output components. Running the file opens the demo at http://localhost:7860; in a notebook it appears inline.
Run gradio app.py instead of python app.py for hot reload, and add --vibe for an in-browser chat that edits your app in natural language. Gradio is Apache 2.0 licensed.
